title: Chemical Reactors
summary: Custom chemical reactor vessels with project-specific agitation, heating and cooling systems, materials and mechanical design requirements.
body:
Tongyang manufactures custom chemical reactor vessels for batch reaction, mixing and temperature-controlled process duties. Reactor configuration is developed around the specified process medium, operating envelope, mixing requirements, material compatibility and project scope. Depending on the application, the supply may include an agitator drive, shaft and impeller, heating/cooling jacket or internal coil, nozzles and agreed instrumentation interfaces.

Types and configurations

  • Agitated reactor vessels: for batch mixing, blending and reaction duties
  • Jacketed reactors: for heating or cooling through an external jacket
  • Coil-equipped reactors: for specified heating or cooling duties using internal coils
  • Stainless steel reactors: for services requiring suitable corrosion resistance
  • Custom process reactors: mechanical configurations based on project-specific dimensions, internals and connections

Industries and typical applications

  • Specialty and industrial chemical production
  • Petrochemical additives and formulated products
  • Batch processing, mixing and blending
  • Temperature-controlled chemical reactions
  • Corrosion-sensitive services requiring a suitable material selection

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Capacity and process medium: total and working volume, composition, viscosity, density and solids content
  • Operating envelope: operating/design pressure, vacuum requirements, temperature and batch cycle
  • Mixing system: mixing duty, impeller type, rotational speed, motor power, seal arrangement and hazardous-area requirements
  • Heating and cooling: jacket or coil configuration, heating/cooling medium, utility conditions and required duty
  • Mechanical scope: wetted materials, corrosion allowance, nozzles, supports, valves, instrumentation and control interfaces
  • Quality and compliance: applicable design code, inspection, testing, documentation and destination-market requirements

Materials, engineering and applicable standards

Materials are selected according to process chemistry, corrosion requirements, temperature and mechanical design conditions. Pressure-containing parts are reviewed against the agreed design code, such as ASME Section VIII or GB/T 150 where applicable. Agitator selection, motor and electrical protection requirements, and temperature or pressure interlocks must be confirmed against the process hazard assessment and agreed supply scope.

Detailed process design, reaction kinetics, mixing performance guarantees and proprietary process technology are not assumed to be included in vessel fabrication. These responsibilities and deliverables must be clearly defined in the project specification and quotation.

Temperature-control equipment

For projects that require dedicated heat-transfer equipment in addition to a reactor jacket or coil, explore our industrial heat exchangers, coolers and heaters. The final arrangement depends on the process and utility data.

Preparing a reactor RFQ

To support an initial technical review, provide the reactor volume, process medium, operating and design conditions, required materials, agitator details, heating/cooling requirements and applicable design code. Available drawings, a process data sheet and the required supply scope are also helpful.

Quotation basis: final design, accessories, control scope, inspection, testing, certification and delivery schedule are subject to review and confirmation of the project specification.
